findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed several staff members donning gloves without washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and education was carried out to correct the behavior. Ensure that all staff are knowledgeable to wash their hands before donning new gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (1) Rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) Apply an amount of cleaning compound recommended by the cleaning compound manufacturer; (3) Rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds while: (a) Paying particular attention to removing soil from underneath the fingernails during the cleaning procedure, and (b) Creating friction on the surfaces of the hands and arms or surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms, finger tips, and areas between the fingers; (4) Thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed grabbing ready to eat food (fries) for multiple orders with their bare hands. Education was carried out. Four plates of food involved in the bare handling were discarded while inspector was present. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that employees are reminder to avoid bare handling ready to eat food at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following food contact surfaces were observed to be soiled.
1. The soda nozzles on the lobby soda machine. PIC was made aware. The nozzles were cleaned and sanitized while inspector was present. (COS)
2. (REPEAT) The ice machine baffle was observed to have soil accumulation. The PIC was informed to have the baffle cleaned, sanitized and kept free of soil accumulation. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the soda nozzles and the ice machine baffle is cleaned to sight and touch. The inspector will follow-up on 06/08/2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There were no sanitizer/sani bucket observed in the kitchen or prep area upon arrival and during today’s inspection. Education was carried out. PIC was informed. Sanitizer for the sani buckets were made and tested at 100 ppm. Ensure that there is always sanitizer made and placed in the sani buckets during food prep, handling, and service at all times.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed to be in need of repair:

1. SECOND REPEAT  Holes were observed in the wall above the dish machine on the right side. The condition was discussed with the PIC to have the holes sealed.
2. REPEAT Coving tiles beneath the drive-through, between the walk-in freezer and cooler, and behind the ice machine were observed to have peeled away from the wall. The PIC was informed and instructed to have the tiles properly secured and caulked.
3. Inspector observed a broken tile trapping soil and grease underneath the middle grill on the cook line. 

Ensure walls, tiles, and fixtures are maintained in good repair and sealed to allow for proper cleaning at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THRICE REPEAT: The walk-in freezer door was observed not closing completely due to improper latching and ice accumulation. Cold air was observed leaking from gaps around the doors. The ice accumulation was cleaned and the door closed properly. Ensure that ice accumulations are removed to avoid the improper sealing of the Walk-in freezer.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
